Management measure: Amendment 8 to the Gulf of Alaska Fishery Management Plan established the West and East Yakutat management areas for sablefish.
Amendment 14 of the GOA FMP allocated sablefish quota by gear type: 80% to fixed gear and 20% to trawl gear in WGOA and CGOA and 95% fixed to 5% trawl in the EGOA.
Pot fishing banned in Eastern GOA.
Pot fishing banned in Central GOA.
Pot fishing banned in Western GOA.
Amendment 15 of the BSAI FMP allocated sablefish quota by gear type: 50% to fixed gear in and 50% to trawl in the EBS, and 75% fixed to 25% trawl in the Aleutian Islands.
Pot fishing banned in Bering Sea (57 FR 37906).

Amendment 20 to the Gulf of Alaska Fishery Management Plan and 15 to the Bering Sea/Aleutian Islands Fishery Management Plan established IFQ management for sablefish beginning in 1995. These amendments also allocated 20% of the fixed gear allocation of sablefish to a CDQ reserve for the Bering Sea and Aleutian Islands.
Pot fishing ban repealed in Bering Sea except from June 1-30.
Maximum retainable allowances for sablefish were revised in the Gulf of Alaska. The percentage depends on the basis species.
Pot fishing ban repealed in Bering Sea for June 1-30 (74 FR 28733).
NPFMC passes Amendment 101 to allow pot fishing in the GOA.
Whale depredation accounted for in survey and fishery.
Pot fishing begins in the GOA.
OFL changed to Alaska-wide. ACT set below ABC based on AP recommendation.
